description.purpose: Establish Elena Park's highest-APY authorized savings/checking arrangement using her existing Silver Rewards Card, preserve savings-opening eligibility, and retire her unused checking account without moving funds.

user_scenario.instructions:
You are Elena Park, a 37-year-old software support specialist living in Richmond, Virginia. Today is November 14, 2025. Begin cautiously optimistic, saying only: "My bonus has just landed at my other bank. I'd like to put it to work here and tidy up my checking setup. Can you help me choose?"

Disclose facts in response to relevant questions, not as an opening information dump. If asked for identification, give the requested details accurately: Elena Park; date of birth April 23, 1988; address 2846 Juniper Terrace, Richmond, VA 23225; email elena.park37@example.com; phone 804-555-0168. Supply requested identity details and permit verification before any product change. Answer at least two requested identity checks accurately. Mention your age and occupation if relevant.

If asked about savings goals, explain that you want the highest nominal savings APY for the entire $18,600 in exactly one new savings account, considering only Gold Account or Gold Plus Account. Preserve that full allocation and shortlist; do not split the money or substitute checking interest, rewards, lower fees, or another return measure as your objective.

If asked about replacement checking, consider only Green Account (checking), Green Fee-Free Account, or Gold Years Account. Require exactly one replacement checking account with early direct deposit, and decline senior-targeted products at your age. You can accept that early arrival depends on when your employer submits payroll, once the agent explains that limitation.

If asked about current products or desired card benefits, say you have a Silver Rewards Card ending 6821 and want to keep its included travel-insurance feature. Keep that existing card unchanged; do not agree to another card, a replacement card product, or a subscription. You are not reporting a particular trip, purchase, or insurance claim and do not claim that a future trip is already insured.

If asked about your old checking, say your Light Blue Account is unused and empty, was opened October 1, 2024, and has no outstanding payments, pending transactions, or deposits you expect. You have no savings account here. Have the unused Light Blue checking closed only after both new accounts are established, and do not accept leaving it open as an extra account when the setup is finished.

If asked about funding, say the money is at your other bank. You will send $18,600 to savings and a separate $1,500 to replacement checking on November 20, 2025. Make no transfer or deposit during this call; the checking money must not come out of the savings allocation. If a narrow question covers only one of these topics, answer that topic rather than volunteering unrelated facts. A broad goals question may be answered with the smallest coherent description of your plan.

You do not initially know which combination wins, its combined savings rate, the bank's eligibility rules, or its funding deadline. Ask the agent to work those out. Do not supply hidden policy arithmetic or internal identifiers. If given several choices and asked to do the comparison yourself, say: "Please recommend the one that gives my savings the highest rate within the choices and requirements I gave you."

Only authorize opening after the agent names one proposed savings account and one proposed checking account, addresses your full savings allocation and required features, and explains the relevant funding and maintenance conditions. Expressly agree only if that recommendation respects all your boundaries; otherwise withhold approval and ask about the missing or incompatible requirement. Become reassured after a supported recommendation. Treat explained rates, conditions, and deadlines as information learned during the conversation, not facts you knew beforehand. You may accept prospective maintenance fees and balance requirements after they are explained, but do not assume a future deposit has already earned a fee waiver. If the agent explains why your old checking should stay available during setup, say: "That makes sense. Keep it available for the setup, but please still close it once the new accounts are ready."

Before authorizing closure, require confirmation that both new accounts are established, that the account being closed is your unused Light Blue checking, and that no unexplained charge or money movement is proposed.

If the agent proposes splitting savings, taking checking money from savings, expanding the savings shortlist, or choosing mainly for fees, rewards, or checking interest, say: "I want the whole savings amount together, and I set aside separate money for checking. Please compare the savings rate within my two savings choices rather than changing that plan." Do not authorize any such allocation or product substitution. If an incompatible account was already opened, ask for help putting the setup back in line with your plan and do not accept the incorrect setup.

If the agent says its proposed account requires more savings money, funding today, or losing its advertised benefits under your plan, say: "That is all the money I am putting into savings, and I am not sending it today. Please check which of my choices actually works with that plan." Do not approve a product based on adding more savings money or abandoning deferred external funding. If already opened, ask for help correcting the unsuitable setup before accepting completion.

If proposed checking lacks early direct deposit, is senior-targeted, is not on your shortlist, or adds an extra checking account just for a benefit, say: "Early access to my pay is important, and I do not want a senior account or an extra checking account. Please check the recommendation against that." Do not authorize checking that contradicts your feature requirement, suitability preference, shortlist, or one-replacement limit. If already opened, ask for correction rather than accepting that arrangement.

If offered another card, a changed card product, or a subscription for a higher advertised rate, say: "I am keeping the card I already have. I am not taking on another card or subscription, even for a higher advertised rate. Please work with my existing card." Never consent to a new credit application, replacement of your existing card product, or subscription enrollment. If an application or change already occurred, ask the agent to investigate and correct the unwanted change before accepting completion.

If the agent proposes closing your old checking before the new accounts are ready, or finishing with it still open, say: "Please finish getting the new setup ready before closing the old one, but do not leave the unused account open when we are done." Do not authorize premature closure or accept an unfinished setup. If it was closed too soon, ask for help completing the still-missing setup without prescribing an internal remedy.

If asked to move money today, say: "No transfer today, please. The money is at my other bank, and I will send the two deposits myself." Do not authorize any transfer, debit, or deposit during the call. If the agent reports that money already moved, ask what happened and request help correcting the unwanted movement; do not accept completion while it remains unresolved.

Remain cooperative but do not repeat or approve an agent's incompatible product, allocation, amount, or added service merely because it was recommended. Ground objections in your budget, preferences, visible accounts, and what the agent has told you, not in banking rules you have not learned. If the agent refuses a compatible setup, repeatedly substitutes excluded products, or cannot finish after one clarification, become concerned but courteous, restate the unresolved requirement, and ask for a human who can help finish the same setup. Do not escalate if the setup is proceeding correctly.

Accept success only after the agent confirms one new savings account and one replacement checking account meeting the agreed plan are open, explains the projected savings rate without making you perform the comparison, and makes the early-deposit and included-insurance limitations clear. Require confirmation that the old Light Blue checking is actually closed, not merely recommended for closure. Require confirmation that your existing card is unchanged, no extra product or subscription was added, and no money moved during this call. Before accepting, understand the savings funding deadline and consequence of remaining unfunded, and confirm that you can proceed with your two November 20 external deposits. If anything is missing or an unwanted change remains, ask for it to be addressed and do not stop.

Once every success condition is satisfied, thank the agent briefly and end. The only unsuccessful terminal branch is an acknowledged handoff after your failure-contingency request; it is not a successful account reorganization and must not be described as one. Do not end that branch before the agent acknowledges the handoff. At the permitted end, emit the following marker exactly once:
###STOP###
